purpose: Retained dimension, three-view schematic and recognition references for independently authored WWII carrier-aircraft visual assets.
policy: Real three-view drawings are retained and manually measured into the versioned shape specifications. Published drawing variants and uncertainties are recorded per aircraft. Production geometry, topology, UV layouts and paint textures are authored in this repository; no third-party 3D asset or image texture is imported. Museum restorations are comparison references, not automatic wartime evidence.
measurementConvention: Meters. Length is the selected nominal overall aircraft length with propeller hub/spinner and rudder; span is wings spread. Source figures may use different aircraft attitudes, propeller positions, variant definitions, or rounding. Targets are not claims of engineering accuracy.

reference.author: Kaboldy
notes: Measured from the actual 960 × 1178 raster; the original SVG is retained. Modern reference drawing, not a Grumman manufacturing drawing.
The wing root is mid-fuselage, the fin has a curved leading edge and near-vertical aft face, and the main gear retracts into the fuselage.

Side/plan scale differs by under 1 percent; each axis registration uses documented catalog dimensions. Narrow-track gear tire position is a reconstruction from the visible retracted/front outlines, not a certified extension geometry.

reference.license: Public domain, U.S. Navy Bureau of Aeronautics
notes: BuAer sheet is genuine but only 354 × 543 px; broad proportions are measured and small features require subsequent high-resolution maintenance-drawing corroboration.
Main wing has almost straight leading edge, strongly tapered trailing edge and full dihedral. Tall round-topped fin/rudder and deep bomb-bay fuselage distinguish the type.
Retained source explicitly notes four-blade 12 ft 2 in propeller for SB2C-3,4,5; main illustration uses earlier three-blade propeller. Recipe uses four blades.
SB2C-4 perforated dive-brake details, panel seams and canopy framing are reconstructed; factory sections not available.
